summary.key_theme: 受惠於 AI 資料中心基礎設施需求強勁，分析師普遍調升目標價並給予買進評級，儘管市場對其現金流估值存有疑慮。

bullish.title: Bernstein Upgrades Quanta Services to Outperform, Raises Price Target to $775
bullish.reason: Bernstein 分析師 Chad Dillard 將評級從「中立」調升至「優於大盤」，並將目標價上調至 775 美元，顯示對公司在基礎設施領域的成長潛力具高度信心。

bullish.title: Quanta Services Stock Rises on Upgrade. Here’s Why Labor Is the Key.
bullish.reason: 指出熟練勞動力短缺是建設資料中心的瓶頸，而 Quanta Services 具備相關人力優勢，將加速其獲利成長。

bullish.title: Buy 3 AI-Led Stocks Amid Solid Estimate Revisions and Upside Potential
bullish.reason: AI 需求持續推動公司成長，獲利預估值不斷上調，顯示短期股價仍具備上漲動能。

bullish.title: Wall Street Analysts See a 26.45% Upside in Quanta Services (PWR): Can the Stock Really Move This High?
bullish.reason: 市場平均目標價顯示約 26.5% 的潛在上漲空間，反映華爾街對該公司長期基本面的樂觀看法。

bullish.title: Quanta Services (NYSE:PWR): High Growth Momentum Meets a Breakout Setup
bullish.reason: 技術面顯示強勁的成長動能與突破型態，有利於短期股價表現。

bearish.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Stock Looks Pricey Against Its Cash Flow Outlook
bearish.reason: 儘管公司在 AI 基礎設施領域表現強勁，但市場擔憂其當前股價相對於現金流展望而言過於昂貴。

bearish.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Registers a Bigger Fall Than the Market: Important Facts to Note
bearish.reason: 股價單日下跌 1.2%，表現弱於大盤，反映短期獲利了結賣壓。

bearish.title: Sterling vs. Quanta: Which Infrastructure Stock Is the Better Buy?
bearish.reason: 比較顯示競爭對手 Sterling 在估值與資本回報率 (ROIC) 上具備優勢，對 Quanta 的投資吸引力構成相對壓力。

neutral.title: ServiceNow, Quanta Services And More On CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
neutral.reason: 僅為財經節目觀點分享，雖提及分析師升評，但屬於市場情緒參考，對股價無直接實質影響。

neutral.title: Are Options Traders Betting on a Big Move in Quanta Services Stock?
neutral.reason: 僅提及選擇權市場波動，未明確指出看漲或看跌方向，屬中性觀察。

neutral.title: D.H. Griffin Automates Operational Compliance with Powerfleet Unity's AI-Powered Connected Intelligence
neutral.reason: 此新聞涉及代碼為 PWR 的 Powerfleet 公司，與 Quanta Services (PWR) 混淆，對 Quanta Services 無影響。
